name: Kahila garland-lily
desc: Kahila garland-lily (Hedychium gardnerianum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 318 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hedychium gardnerianum, the Kahili ginger, Kahila garland-lily or ginger lily, is a species of flowering plant in the ginger family Zingiberaceae, native to the Himalayas in India, Nepal, and Bhutan.
